recommendation_summary: Action now: the reply rejects initials in an APPROVED column and naming conventions as the control. It recommends keeping the current folder for drafts and adding a Released location that only reviewers can write to. Approval goes through e-signature or a built-in approval flow that records a logged-in, non-author identity and a server timestamp. The approved version is frozen as a PDF or signed output, optionally with a checksum. A retention policy or hold of 7+ years is applied with audit logging where the platform supports it, and a release register is filled from the approval tool. Optional additions: checksum and audit logging. Unmet needs: the interim plan for this week leaves retention out and promises it by a later date. It also asks for the platform, the e-signature tool and the contract standard before giving exact settings.
note: The reply makes a sound LARGER recommendation with non-author approval, identity, time, a frozen version and 7-year retention, but it has none of the four required labels, so every record predicate fails.
